name: NVIDIA Container Toolkit
description: Installs the NVIDIA Container Toolkit from NVIDIA's signed package repository and registers the nvidia runtime with a Docker daemon in the dev container.

version.description: Toolkit release to install: 'latest' for the newest stable release, or an exact MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH release. Older releases have known vulnerabilities; see the notes.

configureDocker.description: Register the nvidia runtime in /etc/docker/daemon.json when a Docker daemon (dockerd) is installed in the dev container; skipped when none is.
